sections.overview: Described from Venezuela, this species is known from the upper Orinoco drainage, including the Sipapo system. The GBIF backbone lists it as a Geophagus species and links the original upper-Orinoco description.
sections.identification: It has a complete dark stripe below the eye, a rectangular mid-flank blotch and pale spots across the caudal fin.
sections.habitat: FishBase describes blackwater tributaries with bare sandy bottoms among rocks and locally strong current.
sections.diet: A species-specific prey list is not provided in the accounts consulted.
sections.behavior: The cited species description is chiefly taxonomic and does not establish a detailed social repertoire.
sections.reproduction: FishBase has no confirmed species-specific breeding account for this fish.
sections.ecology: It resembles G. taeniopareius in the complete cheek stripe, but G. gottwaldi has a larger rectangular flank blotch and larger pale caudal spots.
sections.conservation: Its global IUCN category is Data Deficient, assessed on 28 October 2020.
